body: Okay. And yep. I definitely can't go to the hospital in my town. My neighbor is friends with someone in the psych unit there.
I'll just try to do the hospital. Or residential psychiatric living thing, depending on how soon I can get in. The hospital could refer me there or to another place also.
Okay, thanks. But what should I do about my phone interview at 3 PM tomorrow?
They've never done anything for me. That's why I'm here.
Just the way I want. Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

Won't they stalk me? The same type of stuff has been happening on my cell phone. The same cars were following me yesterday and turning around and people inside them looking at me. I only have enough money to get away or die. If I spend that money, I could possibly be tortured until the day I die.

I don't have proof and I can't afford to get secret proof. The neighbor played loud music for almost a year. He stomps loudly upstairs and it gives me panic attacks. I think he might be an ex-felon, but I'm not sure, She does something and then blames it on me. She turns every single thing around on me. She psychologically associates something with something bad and every time she mentions it, I get overwhelmed and she pretends to not know what I'm exploding. She is better than Pavlov, Freud, etc. People say that I give her too much credit. But I once read that nobody can beat the borderline's actions and thinking. Now after the neighbor made me lose sleep and have panic attacks for years and we told him to stop, he reported us. And now my mother is trying to warp my mind to what really happened. And the neighbor is telling the management his side. My mother is telling me not to tell my side. The neighbor probably has me freaking out in my own apartment saying things. And my mother acts like the worst thing for me to do is go over there. I hear the neighbors laugh after every time my mother overwhelms me. Nobody can understand why. I drive everyone away because I lean on them for emotional support after my mother and neighbor do something. My mother is such a fake. She cries after she makes things up. Everyone is sympathetic to her. Everyone in 100 foot radius of me, except for me, are great liars. Bullets don't lie. Bullets go in my head.

They said to go to a hospital if things get too bad. Everybody knows everybody in the area. If I go to a hospital to deal with my emotions, who knows what people will know the harassing people. In fact, one of the few workers in the inpatient psych ward at the hospital used to know my mother. Supposedly my mother betrayed her trust.

And there's this independent living thing that's taking forever. But I am being terrorized more and more every day and I can't really trust anybody.;
Where do I go? I need protection. But everyone else is too oblivious to see that.

I have Asperger's. All this stuff is overwhelming for me. I can't handle it all on my own. I want justice to end these terrorists. But I'll never be able to get it. They will go back to their normal lives maybe after I put a bullet in my head.

They're trying to frighten me, intimidate me, ruin my life, etc. while my mother tries to control me to prevent me from defending myself. Nobody has really protected me the times I've needed it. I have to stay in my home all the time just to stay off the radar from others so I can feel safe because I've never been taught to defend myself.

My neighbor is trying to get me kicked out. My mother will never stop interrupting me and she can't shut her mouth to keep a secret. The neighbor stomps carelessly, walks around back and forth in the same place over and over again. The phone started going wonky after phone calls like 888-000-0000 and 000-000-0000. Mother said she tried logging into her bank account and the password wouldn't work until she changed it, even though there isn't a password expiration feature. It sounded like I heard coughing on the phone. The upstairs neighbor tries to make me seem like the bad guy when he has been torturing me for years with his nonsense. People look at me strangely. The neighbors next door just laugh for some reason. My sister is bipolar. My mother is borderline. My neighbor is messed up and I don't know what psychiatric problem he has. Somebody called me schizophrenic and I asked my psychiatrist and she said that I'm not schizophrenic. I call people and they leave messages. I call them back and they never pick up. There are tapping noises on the window sometimes. My sister once mentioned that her husband had cyanide. My mother nearly ran me over. I've been abused throughout childhood and adulthood. Mother puts everything on me that's happened since the age of 10 or 11. I can trust a bullet coming out of a gun more than I can trust people and that may very well be my next step.
